settings.loss_microbatch_note: Loss scoring only. Cap at 16 for at least 75 GiB VRAM, 8 for at least 45 GiB, otherwise 4. Generation always uses batch size 1. Record the actual loss microbatch in run_config.json.
settings.loss_definition: Mean next-token cross entropy on the full clean-generated continuation, including its stop token. Average tokens within a passage, then average the 256 passages. Prompt tokens and padding are excluded.
settings.score_definition: single-head target loss minus clean target loss, less single-head distant loss minus clean distant loss
